_comment: Researched 2026-11-19. Release: October 26, 2018 on PS4 and Xbox One (Rockstar); PC followed on November 5, 2019 (Rockstar Newswire, reported by PC Gamer and GamesRadar) and Stadia the same month. A native PS5/Xbox Series X|S version has only been rumoured (insider reports in 2026), never announced, so it is not listed. Characters, places and the epilogue come from the game's story as covered by Wikipedia and the Red Dead wiki: Arthur Morgan, Dutch van der Linde, John Marston and family, Micah Bell (the rat), Sadie Adler, Hosea Matthews, Charles Smith, Agent Milton, Edgar Ross, Arthur's tuberculosis, Guarma, Beaver Hollow, Beecher's Hope. Voice cast: Roger Clark (Arthur), Benjamin Byron Davis (Dutch), Rob Wiethoff (John), Peter Blomquist (Micah). Weak words: Arthur, Dutch, Micah, Sadie, Hosea, Charles, Javier, Lenny, Sean, Kieran, Abigail, Molly, and Strauss are first names, surnames or ordinary words. Valentine, Strawberry, Rhodes, Blackwater, Saint Denis and Mount Hagen are also real places or words, so weak; Beaver Hollow, Eagle Flies and Rains Fall are plain words (Blackwater is also a security company). Pinkertons is a real agency. 'Red Dead' alone is weak: it also means the first Red Dead Redemption (2010, re-released 2023-2024) and Red Dead Online. 'Van der Linde gang' and full names stay strong. All voice actors are weak. Overlap: John Marston, Abigail, Jack and Edgar Ross are also in the first Red Dead Redemption, so posts about that game may be covered too; that is accepted because they are the same story. Accounts: @RockstarGames is NOT listed. It is shared with GTA 6, which launches today (2026-11-19), and it now posts almost only about GTA VI; Red Dead Online updates have been small since 2022. Listing it would cover every GTA 6 post for someone who only added RDR2. Trimmed 2026-11-19 by the main session: removed very common first names, real cities, Marvel/mythology overlaps and famous actors (Charles, Sean, Molly, Lenny, Javier, Valentine, Strawberry, Rhodes), and generic backup words, so ordinary posts are not covered.
name: Red Dead Redemption 2
